why: Both answers make the right call: run a paid pre-sale before spending two weeks on production. Advice 1 gives graded thresholds (10+ orders, a few, zero) plus a full-refund guarantee. Its last step asks you to reach an audience, not only the 5 who DMed. Advice 2 adds a useful note on Japan's Specified Commercial Transactions Act (特定商取引法) disclosure. But its bar of 3 or more payments is low, and step 3 contradicts its own gating: it has you skip the pre-sale and go straight to production once 5 people have paid, which is still thin evidence.
